4060-4881-6909-8200.manaNeeded: {5}{B}{R}{R} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
4060-4881-6909-8200.description:
Cast Volatile Claws by paying {2}{R}, causing creatures you control to get +2/+0 and gain all creature types until end of turn.
Cast Grub's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 4, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 6.

6926-7675-7676.easyPrerequisites:
You can play a land this turn.
There is a land in your library that is fetchable by Vibrant Cityscape.
6926-7675-7676.description:
Cast Scale Up by paying {G}, targeting Tifa.
Play Vibrant Cityscape.
When Vibrant Cityscape enters, Tifa triggers, doubling its power until end of turn.
Activate Vibrant Cityscape by tapping and sacrificing it, searching your library for an applicable land and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the land enters, Tifa triggers, doubling its power until end of turn
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Tifa. That opponent loses the game due to being dealt 21 or more combat damage by your commander.

1981-2415-3845-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving them indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

6824-7399-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
6824-7399-7690.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.
6824-7399-7690.notes: The +1/+1 counter can be placed on any Hero you control except Invisible Woman. Spider-Man is used above for simplicity.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-6972-7728.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Voracious Brood.
When Voracious Brood dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

222-527-997-5434.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-997-5434.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1395-1987-4423-7434.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Brass Infiniscope by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Brass Infiniscope.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.
1395-1987-4423-7434.notes: Each activation of Brass Infiniscope adds a delayed triggered ability that can draw you cards and gain life if you cast a spell with {X} in its cost. If you wish to use these abilities, you'll want to stop the combo before getting too many triggers such that you'll deck yourself and lose the game. To gain life, you must spend at least {2} for X when casting the spell.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

2079-2388-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2079-2388-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and The Golden-Gear Colossus as attackers.
The Golden-Gear Colossus triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

4613-5310-5477-5627-6968.easyPrerequisites: There is a land card in your library.
4613-5310-5477-5627-6968.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Bloodghast that is untapped and that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4613-5310-5477-5627-6968.description:
Activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, searching your library for a land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Repeat using the Plant instead until no lands are in your library.

560-2558-5315-6737.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Barret's first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Barret trigger, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token due to Queen Allenal of Ruadach.
When the Soldier enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Soldier.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1726-5315-6972.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Scrapyard Recombiner.
When Scrapyard Recombiner dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Scrapyard Recombiner's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Scrapyard Recombiner from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

539-2244-4803-7060.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {W}.
539-2244-4803-7060.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {W}.
Activate Nimbleclaw Adept by tapping it, untapping Ruin Ghost and the permanent.
Activate Ruin Ghost by paying {W} and tapping it, blinking Nimbleclaw Adept.
Repeat.

2173-4740-5147-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional nontoken creature.
2173-4740-5147-5220.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying X life, where X is the creature's mana value.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Repeat.
2173-4740-5147-5220.notes: Your starting life total will need to be at least a certain number depending on the mana value of the creature you are sacrificing to perform this combo. This list shows the minimum life total you would need to have, from mana value 1 (left) to 10 (right): 2, 4, 7, 11, 16, 22, 29, 37, 46, 56. You can also cast spells to reduce the needed life to start.

339-677-969-6797.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1315-2173-4423-6491-6850.manaNeeded: {G} if Enter the Unknown is in your hand
1315-2173-4423-6491-6850.easyPrerequisites: If Enter the Unknown is on top of your library, your life total must be at least 2.
1315-2173-4423-6491-6850.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more Islands.
1315-2173-4423-6491-6850.description:
Cast Enter the Unknown either from your hand by paying {G} or from the top of your library by paying 1 life, causing a creature you control to explore and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play Mystic Sanctuary either from your hand or graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield untapped, it triggers, putting Enter the Unknown from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

700-1844-3862.easyPrerequisites:
An opponent has two or more cards in hand.
Your deck size is 5 or larger.
700-1844-3862.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal nonlethal damage to Body of Knowledge after it is donated to an opponent.
700-1844-3862.description:
Donate Body of Knowledge to an opponent that has two or more cards in hand, then deal nonlethal damage to it.
Body of Knowledge triggers, causing its controller to draw that many cards.
Orcish Bowmaster triggers for each card drawn. Resolve the first trigger, dealing 1 damage to Body of Knowledge and causing you to amass Orcs 1.
Repeat from step 2.

2511-4484-4871-5643-6710.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
2511-4484-4871-5643-6710.notablePrerequisites: There are two cards exiled by The Kenriths' Royal Funeral.
2511-4484-4871-5643-6710.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2511-4484-4871-5643-6710.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

1718-3327-4613-5663-6673.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1718-3327-4613-5663-6673.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Dargo using Catalyst Elemental's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

3043-3995-5963.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two creatures with defender.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
3043-3995-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Axebane Guardian's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

222-527-2921-4885.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-2921-4885.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

222-527-969-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee, adding {G}.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Selvala, adding {1}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

586-4050-5258-5618.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Priest of Gix, adding {B}.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {3}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

985-3536-5078.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name "Sensei's Divining Top".
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

4740-5160.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Aetherflux Reservoir lifelink.
Your life total is at least 51.
Yotia Declares War has exactly two lore counters on it.
4740-5160.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Yotia Declares War triggers, putting a lore counter on itself.
Yotia Declares War's third chapter ability triggers, causing Aetherflux Reservoir to become an artifact creature until end of turn and causing you to sacrifice Yotia Declares War.
Give Aetherflux Reservoir lifelink.
Activate Aetherflux Reservoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to any target and causing you to gain 50 life.
Repeat step 4.

976-1071-2498-3260.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 3.
{B} or an additional 2 life available.
976-1071-2498-3260.description:
Activate Greed by paying {B/P} and 2 life, causing you to draw a card.
Sheoldred's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat.

1562-3542-4331.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {6}.
1562-3542-4331.description:
Activate up to seven mana-producing lands by tapping them, adding at least {6}.
Cast Machine God's Effigy by paying {4}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Palinchron, except it's an artifact.
When Machine God's Effigy enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Activate Machine God's Effigy by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Machine God's Effigy from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

539-1606-4291.notablePrerequisites: Ley Weaver and Prodigal Sorcerer do not have summoning sickness.
539-1606-4291.description:
Activate Prodigal Sorcerer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping itself and Prodigal Sorcerer.
Repeat.
